history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration define the roles and responsibilities of budget monitoring of peacekeeping operations by different stakeholders of the second line of defence to ensure that appropriate checks and balances are in place and greater attention is paid to budgetary discipline and mandate priorities.
history.administration_response: The Secretariat is cognizant of the need to further improve accountability and increase existing efforts to strengthen budgetary monitoring and oversight during the financial period. To that end, the scope and delineating responsibilities of budget monitoring by various stakeholders of the second “line of defence” should be clearly defined in the context of the internal controls operating at the first and second lines. With regard to the redeployment of funds, the Controller’s memorandum of 2021 regarding management of allotments and procedures for redeployments reflected checks and balances, to the extent that missions adhere to its provision. To ensure fiscal discipline and control, the Field Operations Finance Division will augment its efforts to support strict compliance with the policy on the management of allotments. Missions have been requested to fully implement the Controller’s directives concerning quarterly mission reports on budget implementation, in a standardized format. For the efficient management of resources within approved budgets, additional coherence will be required at the highest level of organizational leadership in missions, and between the field and Headquarters. The various stakeholders need to proactively communicate, as necessary, throughout the budget period with respect to important foreseen deviations of projected expenditure with major financial implications and assess the impact on the utilization of approved resources. For stringent monitoring during budget implementation and to further enable more responsive anticipation and management of difficulties and risks, this would require the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget to be better informed on the strategic discussions with major budgetary impact by all stakeholders, especially relevant departments and Headquarters offices.
history.board_assessment: In 2023/24, the audits of UNMISS and the Regional Service Centre found that budget implementation reports and expenditure projections for the following quarter or the end of the year were submitted on a quarterly basis. With regard to the role of the Department of Peace Operations within the second line of defence, from budgeting to execution, the 2025/26 budget cycle will allow the implementation of the recommendation to be measured. The work on defining the roles and responsibilities of the various stakeholders is under way, in line with the timeline for implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration define the roles and responsibilities of budget monitoring of peacekeeping operations by different stakeholders of the second line of defence to ensure that appropriate checks and balances are in place and greater attention is paid to budgetary discipline and mandate priorities.
history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. The Field Operations Finance Division is monitoring budget implementation by requesting quarterly expenditure projections and variance analysis, as well as cash projections. To strengthen the monitoring responsibility of stakeholders, a workshop on the second line of defence was held in 2025. Furthermore, a standard operating procedure on the second line of defence in the Division was issued on 17 December 2025.
history.board_assessment: In view of the new standard operating procedure outlining and formalizing the second line of defence in the Field Operations Finance Division, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
